lines.en: label tsuneyoslumber1:
if yumislumber3 == False:
scene mayanebench30
if yumislumber3 == False:
Molly — considering it’s not really possible to call Tsuneyo when I still don’t have her phone number.
lines.zh: Molly——因为我到现在都还没有 Tsuneyo 的电话号码，也不可能真去打电话给她。

lines.en: As such, I tap on her roommate’s name and wait for {i}her{/i} to answer instead.
lines.zh: 于是我点开她室友的名字，转而等{i}她{/i}接听。

lines.en: else:
I tap on Molly's name in my phone and wait for her to answer since I have no way of getting in contact with Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: 我在手机里点开 Molly 的名字，等她接听，因为我没有别的办法联系上 Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : ‘Ello?
: Hey. It’s me. Ignore the unknown number. It’s a long story.
lines.zh: : 嘿。是我。别管这个陌生号码。说来话长。

lines.en: : Why if it ain’t Kael’thas himself!
lines.zh: : 哟，这不是 Kael'thas 本尊吗！

lines.en: : It ain’t. I mean...it {i}isn’t.{/i} Who?
lines.zh: : 不是。我是说……{i}不是{/i}。谁？

lines.en: : Kael’thas Sunstrider, former prince of Quel’Thalas and senior member of the Kirin Tor. And also one of the first video game characters I ever- nope. Shouldn’t tell you that.
lines.zh: : Kael'thas Sunstrider，Quel'Thalas 的前王子，Kirin Tor 的资深成员。也是我最早认识的电子游戏角色之一——不，不该跟你说这个。

lines.en: : Is this the part where you clarify why you thought I was a video game character?
lines.zh: : 所以现在是不是该解释一下，你为什么觉得我是个游戏角色？

lines.en: : Only if it’s the part where you pretend to be interested!
lines.zh: : 除非这正是你装出感兴趣的时候！

lines.en: : It’s not.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : Well, it’s because you came back from the dead. None of us had any idea where you ran off to on Christmas Night, Sir! A regular Irish goodbye if I don’t say so myself. And I can! Because-
lines.zh: : 那是因为你死而复生了。圣诞夜那天你跑哪儿去了，我们谁都不知道，老师！要我说，这就是一场标准的爱尔兰式告别。而我确实说了！因为——

lines.en: : Because you’re Irish, I know. Do you have Tsuneyo’s phone number?
lines.zh: : 因为你是爱尔兰人，我知道。你有 Tsuneyo 的电话号码吗？

lines.en: : Do you not? Aren’t you the father of Noodles the Unholy?
lines.zh: : 你没有吗？你不是邪鸟 Noodles 的爹吗？

lines.en: : When did he earn such a threatening title?
lines.zh: : 他什么时候得了这么个吓人的称号？

lines.en: : 'Tis just the way he strikes me, I suppose. What do you need Tsuneyo’s number for, Sir? Last I heard, you two were still at odds.
lines.zh: : 大概是他给我的感觉就是那样吧。老师，你要 Tsuneyo 的号码干什么？我上次听说，你们俩还势同水火呢。

lines.en: : It’s complicated.
lines.zh: : 事情很复杂。

lines.en: : Does it involve time travel?
lines.zh: : 跟时间旅行有关吗？

lines.en: : No, it- what? How did you know that?
lines.zh: : 不，它——什么？你怎么知道的？

lines.en: : Typical plot development at this point in the story. It was either that or I was about to find out you two have been spoonin’ behind me back this whole time.
lines.zh: : 故事发展到这个阶段，剧情走向通常就是这样。要么是这个，要么就是我马上要发现你俩这段时间一直背着我搂着睡。

lines.en: : You read some weird stories.
lines.zh: : 你都看了些什么奇怪的故事。

lines.en: : Don’t even get me started, Sir. I’ll text you the number now. But I’m gonna warn ye’! Don’t go sendin’ any text messages that may alter the path of the future!
lines.zh: : 别提了，老师。我现在就把号码发给你。不过我可警告你！别发任何可能改变未来走向的短信！

lines.en: : Last thing we need is a world where Ami keeps dying over and over and you’ve gotta work through chronic depression and other shite just to bring ‘er back.
lines.zh: : 我们最不需要的，就是一个 Ami 一遍又一遍死掉、而你必须熬过慢性抑郁和其他破事才能把她带回来的世界。

lines.en: : Number please, Molly.
lines.zh: : 号码就好，Molly。

lines.en: : Aye aye! Until we meet again, Sir!
lines.zh: : 遵命！后会有期，老师！

lines.en: if yumislumber3 == False:
scene black
Just seconds after hanging up the phone, I receive a text containing Tsuneyo’s contact info.
lines.zh: 挂断电话才几秒钟，我就收到了一条短信，里面是 Tsuneyo 的联系方式。

lines.en: But when I go to call her, I quickly take note of the lack of a dial tone or ringing and am left standing on the sidewalk wondering what else I should do to get in contact with her.
lines.zh: 可当我准备拨给她时，我很快注意到既没有拨号音也没有铃声，于是只能站在人行道上，琢磨还有什么办法能联系上她。

lines.en: It’s clear she wasn’t with Molly as I’m {i}pretty{/i} sure she would have informed me of that while we were on the phone, so...
lines.zh: 她显然不在 Molly 身边——我{i}敢肯定{/i}，如果她在，Molly 通电话时就会告诉我，所以……

lines.en: She’s either at the archery range or Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: 她要么在射箭场，要么在 Tojo Ramen。

lines.en: And while I’m significantly closer to school than I am to the second half of town, I have a very strong feeling that going to the former would just be a waste of time in the end.
lines.zh: 虽然我离学校比离城另一头近得多，但我有一种强烈的预感：去前者最后只会是白跑一趟。

lines.en: As such, I set off on what’s sure to be a very long walk-
lines.zh: 于是我踏上了一段注定十分漫长的路——

lines.en: scene tsuneyobridge1
And I arrive.
lines.zh: 然后我到了。

lines.en: Tsuneyo stands at the railing of a bridge where I once met someone doing something after thinking of someone who she’d forgotten or something.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 站在一座桥的栏杆旁——我曾在那里见过某个人，在想起某个她已经忘掉的人之后，做着某件事。

lines.en: She looks up at the sky and thinks of...probably noodles, if I had to take a guess. But I think of something else.
lines.zh: 她抬头望着天空，心里想的……如果让我猜，大概是面条。但我想的是别的。

lines.en: Something pure, though not the type of purity you’d typically associate with someone much stronger than me.
lines.zh: 某种纯粹的东西，虽然不是人们通常会联想到某个远比我强大的人身上的那种纯粹。

lines.en: I think of what it would be like to wake up in a world and not have to worry about who remembers what or when or why any of this is happening in what should have been my peaceful life of debauchery.
lines.zh: 我想的是，醒来面对一个世界，却不必担心谁记得什么、什么时候、为什么这一切会发生在这本该是我安宁的放荡生活里，那会是什么感觉。

lines.en: If those that I have wronged could too live in a world like that, I wonder what would become of us.
lines.zh: 如果那些被我亏欠过的人也能活在这样一个世界里，我想我们最终会变成什么样。

lines.en: And I wonder what would become of me, who sacrificed everything so they could go on untouched.
lines.zh: 我也想知道，为了让她们安然无恙而牺牲了一切的我，会变成什么样。

lines.en: I give up the thought as I don’t have the right to think it.
lines.zh: 我放弃了这个念头，因为我没有资格去想它。

lines.en: Not while I’m still blooming.
lines.zh: 在我还在绽放的时候不行。

lines.en: Not while I’m here with her.
lines.zh: 在我还和她站在这里的时候不行。

lines.en: scene tsuneyobridge2
I take my place beside her and gaze up at the same sky.
lines.zh: 我在她身旁站定，望向同一片天空。

lines.en: Or is it?
lines.zh: 或者说，真的是同一片吗？

lines.en: : Does the weather today strike you as odd?
lines.zh: : 你觉得今天的天气有点反常吗？

lines.en: : Not particularly. But it {i}is{/i} odd to see you out here instead of slaving over a hot stove in an old ramen shop.
lines.zh: : 不觉得。不过看到你站在这儿，而不是在一家老拉面店的滚烫灶台前当牛做马，{i}倒是{/i}挺反常的。

lines.en: : Since the moment I woke up, I've felt like something is wrong. But I suppose it is just me.
lines.zh: : 从我醒来的那一刻起，我就觉得有什么不对劲。但我想，那大概只是我自己有问题。

lines.en: : Perhaps it will rain? That would be exciting, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 也许是要下雨了？那会很令人兴奋吧？

lines.en: : I...guess?
lines.zh: : 我……大概吧？

lines.en: : It doesn’t rain very often. {i}Any{/i} change is exciting.
lines.zh: : 这里很少下雨。{i}任何{/i}变化都令人兴奋。

lines.en: : Which is why I am surprised that standing here fills me not with joy, but with the concerning hope that these calm summer mornings will one day cease to be.
lines.zh: : 所以连我自己都惊讶：站在这里，我心里涌上的不是喜悦，而是一种令人不安的期盼——盼着这些平静的夏日清晨有朝一日不复存在。

lines.en: : When that day comes, I wonder what will happen to this place?
lines.zh: : 当那一天到来时，我想知道这个地方会变成什么样？

lines.en: : I wonder what will happen to me?
lines.zh: : 我想知道我会变成什么样？

lines.en: : You’re in a...{i}different{/i} kind of mood today. Did something happen at the store? Is the power out again?
lines.zh: : 你今天的心情……有点{i}不一样{/i}。店里出什么事了吗？又停电了？

lines.en: : I haven’t returned home yet, so I’m not sure.
lines.zh: : 我还没回家，所以不清楚。

lines.en: : I was on my way there, but felt compelled to stop when I was overcome with a great sense of worry. So great I suppose it could even be called fear.
lines.zh: : 我本来正往那儿走，却被一阵强烈的担忧攫住，不得不停下脚步。强烈到我想那甚至可以被称为恐惧。

lines.en: : Fear of what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 恐惧什么，具体说？

lines.en: : I’m not sure.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。

lines.en: : Perhaps fear itself? That {i}is{/i} the most terrifying thing out there according to a wise man known only as Franklin Delaware Roosevelt.
lines.zh: : 也许是恐惧本身？据一位只被称为 Franklin Delaware Roosevelt 的智者所说，那{i}是{/i}世上最可怕的东西。

lines.en: : I think you’re a little off, but it was a valiant effort.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你说得有点偏差，不过这份努力值得敬佩。

lines.en: scene tsuneyobridge3
: Were you looking for me? Is that why you are here?
lines.zh: : 你是在找我吗？所以你才来这里？

lines.en: : I apologize for the inconvenience, but I will not be able to serve you until I return to the store.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉给您添麻烦，但在我回店里之前，我没法招待您。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I’m not really hungry in the first place. I {i}was{/i} looking for you, though.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我本来也不太饿。不过我{i}确实{/i}在找你。

lines.en: : Why would you come looking for me if you are not hungry? No other motivation makes sense.
lines.zh: : 既然你不饿，为什么还要来找我？想不出别的动机。

lines.en: : I need your help saving the world...or something.
lines.zh: : 我需要你帮忙拯救世界……之类的。

lines.en: : Does it involve time travel? The Emerald Guardian would say that would be a typical tool for plot development at this stage in our relationship.
lines.zh: : 跟时间旅行有关吗？翡翠守护者会说，在我们关系的这个阶段，那是推动剧情的典型手段。

lines.en: : It does and she did. Also, you two are way too close. Start having thoughts of your own again instead of just hijacking all of her geek-knowledge.
lines.zh: : 是有关，她也确实说过。还有，你们俩实在太黏了。别光是照搬她的宅知识，重新开始有自己的想法吧。

lines.en: : If you need assistance constructing a time machine, I regret to inform you that I will be unable to help as I am already employed at a local business. But I wish you the best of luck in your endeavors.
lines.zh: : 如果你需要协助建造时间机器，我很遗憾地通知你，我帮不上忙，因为我已经在本地一家店里任职了。不过祝你的事业一切顺利。

lines.en: : How about just a slumber party then?
lines.zh: : 那开个睡衣派对怎么样？

lines.en: scene tsuneyobridge4
: I’m not sure if that is a good idea. The only time I slept at your house ended rather strangely. It {i}was{/i} nice using your kitchen, though. Even if you do not have an industrial size stock pot.
lines.zh: : 我不确定这是不是个好主意。我唯一一次在你家过夜，结局相当诡异。不过用你的厨房挺不错的。哪怕你没有工业尺寸的高汤锅。

lines.en: : I can...barely even remember you ever sleeping at my house.
lines.zh: : 我……几乎都想不起来你在我家睡过。

lines.en: : That’s unfortunate. I thought it was a nice moment for us. But I suppose we’ll have more opportunities for better moments in the future.
lines.zh: : 那真遗憾。我还以为那是属于我们的一个美好瞬间。不过我想，以后我们会有更多机会创造更好的瞬间。

lines.en: : For now, I...
lines.zh: : 至于现在，我……

lines.en: : ...Need to get back home?
lines.zh: : ……需要回家了？

lines.en: : Actually...
lines.zh: : 其实……

lines.en: scene tsuneyobridge5
: Do you think that we could go somewhere instead? I’m still not comfortable returning to the restaurant at this point in time.
lines.zh: : 你觉得我们能不能换个地方去？此时此刻我还不太想回餐厅。

lines.en: : Is that okay? Won’t it stay closed for the entire day if you’re not there to, you know, {i}open{/i} it?
lines.zh: : 可以吗？你若不去{i}开{/i}门，它岂不是要关一整天？

lines.en: : It will. But business has slowed down as of late and even our regular customers are dropping by less frequently.
lines.zh: : 是的。不过最近生意清淡，连老主顾都来得少了。

lines.en: : I believe that one day off will not cause enough harm to the restaurant to form any long-lasting issues or problems for us.
lines.zh: : 我相信休息一天不会对餐厅造成足以留下长期隐患或问题的伤害。

lines.en: : I mean, I’m fine with it. You deserve a day off. And if you want to spend that day off going on a date with your teacher, that’s completely fine.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我没意见。你该休息一天。而如果你想把这一天用来和你的老师约会，那完全没问题。

lines.en: : Thank you. I appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我很感激。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. I was kind of expecting you to clap back about the date thing. I was just joking, you know. I don’t actually think-
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。我还以为你会就约会那句回呛我。我只是开个玩笑，你知道的。我其实并不认为——

lines.en: : Dating me is a joke to you?
lines.zh: : 和我约会对你来说是个笑话？

lines.en: : What? No.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。

lines.en: : I do not understand. I thought you were attracted to teenage girls?
lines.zh: : 我不明白。我以为你喜欢的是十几岁的少女？

lines.en: : Alright, now I’m just confused.
lines.zh: : 好吧，现在我彻底糊涂了。

lines.en: : That is okay. You are at the point in life where it is normal to question such feelings. Just know that I will respect you the same regardless of your heart’s true desires.
lines.zh: : 没关系。你正处在会质疑这种感情的人生阶段，这很正常。你只需知道，无论你内心真正的渴望是什么，我对你的尊重都不会变。

lines.en: : That-
: It is a very minimal amount of respect, but still. That much will not change.
lines.zh: : 那份尊重的量非常少，但终究不会变。

lines.en: : Is this a date or not? Because that’s not what I came here for, but I’m totally fine with it if you are.
lines.zh: : 这到底算不算约会？因为我来这儿不是为了这个，不过如果你想当约会，我完全 OK。

lines.en: : Plus, it’ll probably make what I actually {i}did{/i} come here for significantly easier in the long run.
lines.zh: : 而且从长远来看，这大概还会让我{i}真正{/i}来这儿的目的变得容易得多。

lines.en: : At least you are honest enough to not hide your ulterior motives any longer. I thank you for that.
lines.zh: : 至少你诚实到不再掩饰自己的别有用心。对此我表示感谢。

lines.en: : Yeah, I could have worded that last sentence better. But I can assure you I didn’t mean it like {i}that.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊，我那句话本可以说得更好。但我向你保证，我不是{i}那个意思{/i}。

lines.en: scene tsuneyobridge6
: It’s fine if you did.
lines.zh: : 如果你是那个意思也没关系。

lines.en: : {i}What?{/i}
: It is only natural that you would want to impregnate me.
lines.zh: : 你想让我怀孕，那再自然不过了。

lines.en: : Have you been drinking or something?
lines.zh: : 你喝酒了还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Extending one’s lineage is a desire ingrained into all men at birth. And it is the same for me as I am the only one who can carry on my family’s legacy at this point in time.
lines.zh: : 延续血脉是男人生来就被植入的欲望。对我来说也一样，因为眼下我是唯一能继承家业的人。

lines.en: : As such, I know that I will one day bear children. And seeing as you are the only man I am in regular contact with, those children would most likely belong to you.
lines.zh: : 所以我知道，我总有一天要生孩子。而既然你是我唯一经常接触的男人，那些孩子很可能就是你的。

lines.en: : Uhh...maybe I should just head back home? This isn’t really a discussion I want to be having.
lines.zh: : 呃……也许我还是直接回家吧？这种话题我真不想聊。

lines.en: scene tsuneyobridge7
: Neither do I. Why would I ever look forward to carrying the children of a man as deplorable as you?
lines.zh: : 我也不想。我怎么会期待怀上一个像你这么可鄙的男人的孩子？

lines.en: : I’m getting so many mixed signals right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在收到的信号真是混乱到家了。

lines.en: : I am simply stating it would make sense to have your children — not that I {i}want{/i} to.
lines.zh: : 我只是在说，怀上你的孩子合乎情理——不是说{i}我想{/i}那么做。

lines.en: : And the date thing?
lines.zh: : 那约会的事呢？

lines.en: scene tsuneyobridge8
: See? If you’re averse to looking at me romantically, don’t sign up to-
lines.zh: : 看吧？如果你不愿意往恋爱那方面看我，就别答应——

lines.en: : Upon careful introspection, I continue to see little downside in regard to something as simple as a date.
lines.zh: : 仔细内省之后，我依然觉得，像约会这么简单的事没什么坏处。

lines.en: : It is my understanding that many dates come with the complete lack of romantic contact. What prevents us from going on a date like that other than your inability to provide a straight answer?
lines.zh: : 据我所知，很多约会是完全不涉及恋爱接触的。除了你给不出一个干脆的回答之外，还有什么能阻止我们进行那样一场约会？

lines.en: : I think the idea of dates {i}like that{/i} is the hope that they will one day lead to something more.
lines.zh: : 我觉得{i}那种{/i}约会的意义，就在于期盼它有朝一日能通向更多的东西。

lines.en: : So...the reason for your hesitancy is because you might one day...want something more?
lines.zh: : 所以……你犹豫的原因，是你有朝一日可能……想要更多？

lines.en: scene tsuneyobridge9
: Again, I don’t understand. Why would that be a problem?
lines.zh: : 我还是不明白。那为什么会是个问题？

lines.en: : It’s not for me. It is for {i}you,{/i} though. Right? Like, you’re clearly not interested in me that way and you’ve made it apparent a number of times now. Why date anyone you feel that way about?
lines.zh: : 对我来说不是。但{i}对你{/i}来说是，不是吗？比如，你明显对我没有那种兴趣，而且已经表达过好几次了。为什么会去约会一个你毫无感觉的人？

lines.en: : Because those thoughts may change. And I don’t understand what the harm would be in providing them the opportunity to.
lines.zh: : 因为那种想法可能会改变。而我看不出给它们一个改变的机会有什么坏处。

lines.en: : What is the sense in depriving oneself of something one may someday enjoy on account of temporary, present-day uncertainties?
lines.zh: : 因为当下暂时的不确定，就剥夺自己有朝一日可能会享受的东西，这有什么道理？

lines.en: : You’re really confusing sometimes, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 你有时候真是让人摸不着头脑，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene tsuneyobridge10
: Ah-
: And you are still doing that, I see...
lines.zh: : 我看你还在做这个动作……

lines.en: scene tsuneyobridge11
: The one who is confusing is you.
lines.zh: : 让人摸不着头脑的人是你。

lines.en: : If you’d simply accepted my acceptance that I may one day have to accept you, our “date” would have been well underway by now.
lines.zh: : 如果你干脆接受我已经接受的那件事——我有一天或许得接受你——我们的“约会”早就顺利开始了。

lines.en: : But I suppose we can call it something else if you are so undoubtedly certain that we will never be anything more than who we are now.
lines.zh: : 不过既然你如此确信我们之间永远不会超越现在的关系，那我们大可换个叫法。

lines.en: : It seems as though I am not the only one who is acting out of sorts today.
lines.zh: : 看来今天状态失常的不止我一个。

lines.en: : All it took was one mention of the minute probability that we will one day learn to cherish one another to leave you staggered and speechless.
lines.zh: : 只不过提了一嘴我们有朝一日学会珍惜彼此那微小的可能性，就让你哑口无言、愣在原地。

lines.en: : I like these new sides of you that you’ve been showing me lately.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你最近展现给我的这些新的一面。

lines.en: : They remind me you have a human side.
lines.zh: : 它们提醒我，你也有作为人的一面。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize I had an {i}inhuman{/i} side.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己还有{i}不人{/i}的一面。

lines.en: : That’s very surprising to me when you’ve always felt part-machine.
lines.zh: : 这让我很惊讶，因为你给人的感觉一直都是半个机器。

lines.en: scene black
Tsuneyo pulls herself away from the bridge and walks toward the center, replicating another view I’ve seen at least once before...
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 从桥边挪开身子，走向桥中央，重现了我至少见过一次的另一个画面……

lines.en: scene tsuneyobridge12
But the sun comforts me in ways that the moon did not.
lines.zh: 但阳光给我的慰藉，是月亮给不了的。

lines.en: It is not the warmth, nor the way I have to shield my eyes from its blinding glow — but the way Tsuneyo catches it between each squint of my eyes.
lines.zh: 不是那份温暖，也不是我必须遮住眼睛挡住它刺眼光芒的方式——而是每一次我眯起眼睛时，Tsuneyo 承接住它的样子。

lines.en: If there is a future for us, I can’t imagine such a view will ever get old.
lines.zh: 如果我们真有未来，我无法想象这样的画面会有一天看腻。

lines.en: But as much as I’d like to believe that she’s thinking the same about me right now...
lines.zh: 但我多希望她此刻心里想的和我一样……

lines.en: I can’t shake the feeling that I’m nothing more than an obstacle stuck between where she currently is and where she {i}wants{/i} to be.
lines.zh: 可我甩不掉那个感觉：我不过是挡在她此刻所在之处与她{i}想去{/i}之处之间的一块绊脚石。

lines.en: Away from here.
lines.zh: 离开这里。

lines.en: Away from the building she grew up in and the rotting shell of what was once a town and a bridge and a sky and streets filled with dust and overgrown weeds-
lines.zh: 离开她长大的那栋楼，离开这座曾经是小镇的腐朽躯壳，离开那座桥、那片天空、那些满是尘土和疯长野草的街道——

lines.en: I get so caught up in my own confusion that I wind up forgetting why I came here in the first place.
lines.zh: 我陷在自己的困惑里太深，结果忘了自己最初是为什么来这儿的。

lines.en: And instead of arriving with the idea that she’s special because she is an outlier, I am {i}leaving{/i} with the knowledge that she is special because she simply {i}is.{/i}
lines.zh: 而来时我带着的想法是：她特别，因为她是个异类；{i}离开{/i}时我得到的认知是：她特别，只因为她{i}是她{/i}。

lines.en: The universe and all of its games have nothing to do with that.
lines.zh: 宇宙和它的一切把戏与此毫无关系。

lines.en: If the future will not force us together, so be it. I can live with one less body beneath my sheets.
lines.zh: 如果未来不会把我们推到一起，那就随它去。我的床单下少一具躯壳，我也能活。

lines.en: But I can {i}not{/i} live if I go on denying the possibility of that.
lines.zh: 但如果我继续否认那种可能性，我就活{i}不{/i}下去。

lines.en: Let this day show me her true colors by transforming her body into a prism that spills its rainbow guts all over me and {i}cleanses{/i} this impure soul of its disease.
lines.zh: 就让这一天向我展示她真正的颜色吧——把她的身体变成一块棱镜，把彩虹般的内脏尽数泼洒在我身上，{i}洗净{/i}这个不洁灵魂里的疾病。

lines.en: : You feel it too, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你也感觉到了，对吧？

lines.en: : Huh?
: The weather.
lines.zh: : 天气。

lines.en: : It’s different today.
lines.zh: : 今天不一样。

lines.en: scene black
I’m not quite sure what she means...but I nod and pretend that I am.
lines.zh: 我不太确定她是什么意思……但我点点头，装作自己懂了。

lines.en: And I let her lead the way to wherever it is we’re going.
lines.zh: 然后我任由她领路，去往我们要去的任何地方。

lines.en: But I’m haunted on the journey by the shadow of something much larger than me.
lines.zh: 可一路上，有个远比我庞大的东西投下的阴影缠着我不放。

lines.en: And my fleeting bliss is plucked from my hands as if it were never mine to enjoy in the first place.
lines.zh: 而我短暂的幸福被人从手中夺走，仿佛它从来就不属于我。

lines.en: Perhaps one day in the future, I will be able to rest.
lines.zh: 也许在未来的某一天，我能够安息。

lines.en: The shadow reminds me in all of my unease that the future may never come if the rise of the moon and its accompanying darkness consumes the other twenty shadows following closely behind.
lines.zh: 我在不安中被那道阴影提醒：如果月亮升起、随之而来的黑暗吞噬了紧随其后的另外二十道阴影，未来也许永远不会到来。

lines.en: The tallest of them all looks the nicest next to mine right now.
lines.zh: 而其中最高的那道，此刻挨在我的旁边，看起来最是温柔。
